slots.name: approval status
slots.sentence: MYQORZO ® ( aficamten ) is a cardiac myosin inhibitor approved in the U.S., China, European Union and United Kingdom for the treatment of symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM).

slots.name: hypertension rate
slots.sentence: MYQORZO is contraindicated with concomitant use of rifampin.
